titulo: Vaccine Therapy in Combination With Rintatolimod and/or Sargramostim in Treating Patients With Stage II-IV HER2-Positive Breast Cancer

braco.nome: Stage I; Arm 5 (HER-2/neu peptide vaccine and rintatolimod)
braco.texto:
Arm 5: HER2 peptide vaccine + 2000 mcg Ampligen®

Five groups of randomized patients with each group receiving the synthetic HER-2/neu peptide vaccine admixed with rintatolimod (different doses).
braco.textoPt:
Braço 5: vacina peptídica HER2 + 2.000 mcg Ampligen®

Cinco grupos de pacientes randomizados, com cada grupo recebendo a vacina sintética HER-2/neu peptídeo misturada com rintatolimod (doses diferentes).
